cmdExtensions.TooltipDescription: Commands added by an extension of AhkWord.

cmdExportMenu.TooltipDescription: Export a copy as PDF, Word or OpenDocument; the document itself stays as it is.

cmdPrintMenu.TooltipDescription: Print, preview and set up the page.

cmdOpen.TooltipDescription: Open a document: HTML, Markdown, RTF, Word, OpenDocument or text.

cmdSaveAs.TooltipDescription: Save the document under a new name or in another format.

cmdPrintPreview.TooltipDescription: See the pages as they will be printed.

cmdExportPdf.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as PDF (through Microsoft Print to PDF).

cmdExportWord.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as a Word document.

cmdExportOdt.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as an OpenDocument text file.

cmdNewFromTemplate.TooltipDescription: Start a new document from a template (letter, memo, report, court paper ... or your own), filling in its fields.

cmdNewWindow.TooltipDescription: Open another AhkWord window, with a new document, to work on two documents at once.

cmdOpenInNewWindow.TooltipDescription: Open a document in another AhkWord window, keeping this one as it is.

cmdStartPage.TooltipDescription: The start page: a blank document, the templates, the recent documents and the macros (it can also be shown at the start).

cmdInsertFromTemplate.TooltipDescription: Insert a template's content at the caret (a caption, a signature block, a certificate of service ...), filling in its fields.

cmdFillInFields.TooltipDescription: Fill in the {{fields}} left in the document, as a template's are filled in (with the values typed last time).

cmdClose.TooltipDescription: Close the document (asking to save its changes) and start an empty one; the window stays open.

cmdPaste.TooltipDescription: Paste the contents of the clipboard.

cmdCut.TooltipDescription: Cut the selection to the clipboard.

cmdCopy.TooltipDescription: Copy the selection to the clipboard.

cmdFind.TooltipDescription: Find text. F3 finds the next match.

cmdChangeCase.TooltipDescription: UPPER CASE, lower case, Title Case or Headline Case.

cmdCaseHeadline.TooltipDescription: Capitalize the words of a heading or title, but not the small words (a, the, of, and) inside it, and keep abbreviations (LLC, N.A.) and legal forms (v., a/k/a) as they are. The word lists: headline-case.txt beside the settings.

cmdUnderlineStyle.TooltipDescription: Single, double, dotted, dashed or wavy underline.

cmdBullets.TooltipDescription: Start or end a bulleted list.

cmdNumbering.TooltipDescription: Start or end a numbered list. Tab and Shift+Tab change the level.

cmdLineSpacing.TooltipDescription: The line spacing of the selected paragraphs: 1.0, 1.15, 1.5, 2.0 ... lines, or exactly or at least so many points (Line Spacing Options).

cmdLineSpacingOptions.TooltipDescription: The Paragraph dialog: line spacing, the space before and after, indents, and the line and page breaks.

cmdParagraphDialog.TooltipDescription: Alignment, indents, spacing, line spacing, line and page breaks (keep with next, keep lines together, widow and orphan control, page break before), and tabs, for the selected paragraphs.

cmdSpaceBefore.TooltipDescription: 12 points before the selected paragraphs (checked: they have space before; click to remove it).

cmdSpaceAfter.TooltipDescription: 12 points after the selected paragraphs (checked: they have space after; click to remove it).

cmdListOptions.TooltipDescription: List styles, list levels (the numbering style of each level), restarting and continuing numbering.

cmdListNone.TooltipDescription: The selected paragraphs are no longer list items: their numbers or bullets go, their text stays.

cmdListLevels.TooltipDescription: Each level's numbering style, punctuation, start number, and where its number and text start (Tab and Shift+Tab change an item's level).

cmdConvertTyped.TooltipDescription: Paragraphs that start with typed numbers such as "1.", "a)" or "(iv)" become list items.

cmdNumberingMenu.TooltipDescription: Start or end a numbered list. The arrow: numbering styles and list levels.

cmdBlockStyle.TooltipTitle: Paragraph style (Ctrl+0 Normal, Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+6 headings, Ctrl+7 Code)
cmdBlockStyle.TooltipDescription: The style of the paragraphs the selection is in: Normal, Title, the headings, Quote, Code and your own (the Styles menu changes them).

cmdStylesMenu.TooltipDescription: Change a style, make a new one from the paragraph at the caret, choose a style set, or keep the styles as your default for new documents.

cmdModifyStyle.TooltipDescription: Change the style of the paragraph at the caret (font, spacing, indents ...); every paragraph with it changes too.

cmdNewStyle.TooltipDescription: A new style, from the paragraph at the caret, given to it.

cmdUpdateStyle.TooltipDescription: Make the caret paragraph's style look like the paragraph (format one paragraph as wanted, then this); every paragraph with the style changes too.

cmdFormatPainter.TooltipDescription: Copy the formatting of the text at the caret, then select other text to give it the same look (whole paragraphs take the paragraph's style, spacing and indents too). Click twice quickly to keep painting; Esc or a click here stops.

cmdClearFormatting.TooltipDescription: The selected text back to its paragraph's style (formatting of its own goes); with no selection, the whole paragraph, its spacing and indents too.

cmdDeleteStyle.TooltipDescription: Delete a style of your own; its paragraphs become Normal.

cmdStyleSetClassic.TooltipDescription: Times New Roman 12, black headings: court papers, contracts, letters.

cmdStyleSetPlain.TooltipDescription: Segoe UI 11, bold headings: the editor's look before styles.

cmdStyleSetModern.TooltipDescription: Georgia text with Segoe UI headings in dark grey, a little more air between lines.

cmdSaveStyles.TooltipDescription: New documents get this document's styles (your changes included).

cmdCopyStyles.TooltipDescription: Bring styles from another document (AhkWord's, Word's, RTF) into this one, and into your defaults for new documents if you like: choose which.

cmdApplyMyStyles.TooltipDescription: Give this document your styles (the ones new documents get): its headings, Normal text and other styles take your look; formatting of a paragraph's own stays.

cmdSectionBreak.TooltipDescription: Start a new section on a new page: its own header and footer (Layout > Header & Footer), its page numbers from 1. For a package of papers in one document.

cmdContinuousBreak.TooltipDescription: Start a new section on this page, so that it can have columns of its own. Layout > Columns with paragraphs selected puts these in for you.

cmdPicture.TooltipDescription: Insert a picture from a file.

cmdThumbnail.TooltipDescription: A small picture that links to the full-size picture.

cmdCrossReference.TooltipDescription: Refer to a numbered paragraph ("see paragraph 3(b)"): the number follows the paragraph's when the paragraphs are renumbered. Ctrl+click it to go there.

cmdFootnote.TooltipDescription: A numbered note at the foot of the page. With the caret on a footnote's number: change its note.

cmdTableOfContents.TooltipDescription: The headings, each with its page, as Word makes it. Update it with F9 (or right-click it). With the caret in one: change its options.

cmdHorizontalLine.TooltipDescription: A line across the text, in a paragraph of its own: printed, and kept in Word, OpenDocument and RTF files; Markdown and HTML get a rule.

cmdSnippets.TooltipDescription: Parts with an abbreviation: typed in the document (then Space or Enter, or at once), an abbreviation becomes its part, formatted. Make one from the selection, change them, or export them as a hotstring script for any program.

cmdUpdateReferences.TooltipDescription: Brings every cross-reference's number up to date. Done by itself as paragraphs are renumbered, and before saving and printing.

cmdLink.TooltipDescription: Insert a link to a web page or file.

cmdHeaderFooter.TooltipDescription: The document's header and footer, with page numbers and dates.

cmdColumns.TooltipDescription: This section's columns on the printed pages. You go on editing in one column; Print Preview shows them.

cmdNextSpelling.TooltipDescription: Go to the next misspelled word. Right-click it for suggestions.

cmdAddToDictionary.TooltipDescription: Add the selected word to the Windows dictionary.

cmdWordWrap.TooltipDescription: Without Print Layout: lines wrap at the window's edge (unchecked: they don't wrap at all, and the window scrolls sideways). With Print Layout, lines break as on the printed page, so this waits until Print Layout is off.

cmdPrintLayout.TooltipDescription: Lines break where they will on the printed page (Page Setup's paper and margins), as in Word and LibreOffice, with the page shown on grey. Off: lines wrap at the window's edge.

cmdShowPages.TooltipDescription: Print Layout: each printed page as a sheet of its own, with its header and footer in its margins, as in Word. A preview, not reliable while typing yet: the view can shift. Off: one long page, with a line where each page begins.

cmdZoomPageWidth.TooltipDescription: Zoom so that the page's width fills the window, as the window is resized too (Print Layout).

cmdZoomOnePage.TooltipDescription: Zoom so that a whole page's height fits in the window (Print Layout).

cmdExportPdfButton.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as PDF, laid out as it prints (through Microsoft Print to PDF; the default printer stays as it is).

cmdZoomMultiplePages.TooltipDescription: The printed pages side by side, as many as fit (read-only; Zoom In and Out, or Ctrl+wheel, show them larger or smaller). Double-click a page to edit it there; Esc goes back.

cmdRuler.TooltipDescription: Show the ruler above the page: the margins, and the indents and tab stops of the paragraph at the caret.

cmdLanguage.TooltipDescription: The language of AhkWord's ribbon, menus and dialogs. It changes when AhkWord starts again.

cmdTheme.TooltipDescription: The colors of the ribbon and the window. The document page stays white in every theme. Between the darker themes the change is at once; to or from Light it starts with the next window.

cmdViewRich.TooltipDescription: Edit the document as formatted text.

cmdViewMarkdown.TooltipDescription: Edit the document as Markdown. Saving a .md file writes your Markdown exactly as typed.

cmdViewHtml.TooltipDescription: Edit the document as HTML. Tags and styles the editor doesn't support are dropped when the formatted view is rebuilt.

cmdSideBySide.TooltipDescription: The Markdown or HTML next to the formatted text, which follows as you type.

cmdMacros.TooltipDescription: Run an AHK script from the rte_macros folder.

cmdRecordMacro.TooltipDescription: Record typing and commands as an AHK script. Mouse clicks are not recorded.

cmdMacroHotkeys.TooltipDescription: Give macros hotkeys that work while the editor is active.

cmdRunScript.TooltipDescription: Run any AHK script against this editor.

cmdEventHooks.TooltipDescription: Macros that run by themselves when AhkWord starts, a document is opened, made, saved, printed or closed, or a style changes: no script of your own kept running.

cmdCommandPalette.TooltipDescription: Type part of a command's name and press Enter: any ribbon command, a macro, a style, a snippet or a recent file.

cmdAutomationApi.TooltipDescription: What AHK scripts can call (RteClient2.ahk: Rte.<Name>(...)).

cmdTableProperties.TooltipDescription: Column widths, borders, shading, row height, alignment and cell padding.

cmdTableBorders.TooltipDescription: Lines around and between the selected cells (or the whole table, if it is selected).

cmdTableShading.TooltipDescription: The background color of the selected cells.

cmdLineNumbers.TooltipDescription: Number the lines in the left margin, as in Word: continuously or restarting on each page. Lines in tables don't count.

cmdSuppressLineNumbers.TooltipDescription: The selected paragraphs' lines get no numbers and are not counted.

cmdLineNumberOptions.TooltipDescription: The first number, the distance from the text, and which numbers are shown (every line's, or every 5th ...).
